annotations.title: A Meta ad account's creative, image, video and label libraries

description: The libraries inside a Meta ad account. resource creatives: list | get (creativeId) | create (a reusable creative WITHOUT an ad: pageId, imageHash or videoId + imageHash as its thumbnail, link, optional message, headline, description, cta, instagramUserId, name; it spends nothing) | rename (creativeId, name: Meta lets only the name change; make a new creative to change its content) | delete (Meta refuses while an ad uses it). resource images: list | get (imageHash) | delete. resource videos: list | get or status (videoId: whether Meta finished processing it) | delete. resource labels: list. Reuse a creative with creativeId, an image with imageHash and a video with videoId on create_meta_ad / update_meta_object. Deletes are permanent and need confirm:true after the user agrees; nothing else spends or changes delivery. Free.

action.description: list (default), get, status (videos), create or rename (creatives), or delete

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_123 or the bare number); it must be one this brand has shared

confirm.description: true after the user agreed to the delete

instagramUserId.description: create: run it on Instagram as this account (list_meta_ad_instagram_accounts)

link.description: create: the https address a click opens

name.description: rename: the new name; create: the creative's name

pageId.description: create: the Facebook Page the ad runs as
